name: Oasis Voice
description: TTS and streaming STT via oasis-voice sidecar (Piper TTS + Moonshine STT on the lite tier; GPU tiers available on the hosted endpoint).
_contracts_NOTE_2026_10_15: REVERSES the 2026-05-16 note (openclaw 2026.4.26), which kept this plugin contracts-less so it would eager-load. On openclaw 2026.7.1 the gateway loads at startup ONLY plugins with activation.onStartup (src/plugins/gateway-startup-plugin-ids.ts shouldConsiderForGatewayStartup), and capability resolution maps a requested provider to its plugin through manifest contracts (src/plugins/capability-provider-runtime.ts). Contracts-less, oasis-voice loaded on some boots and not others; on one bot's 2026-10-15 boot it never loaded and every Telegram voice note failed with 'Media provider not available: oasis-voice'. oasis-semantics recorded the same reversal on 2026-07-11 (contracts make a plugin EAGER on newer openclaw). Keep tools.media.audio.models and messages.tts.provider pinned in the entrypoint as before.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the oasis-voice HTTP server. Default: http://127.0.0.1:8731

tts_voice.description: TTS voice passed to oasis-voice (e.g. piper:en_GB-aru-medium, piper:en_GB-vctk-medium#p236). Default: piper:en_GB-aru-medium

bearer_token.description: Optional Bearer token for hosted/cloud oasis-voice endpoint (CLAW-013+). Not needed for local lite tier.
